correctness.rationale: Direct diagonalization gives singular coefficients r^n|f(n)| for every normalized monomial. The rational-equivalence partition yields exact residue exponentials. Distinct class frequencies have non-torsion ratios and hence distinct characters on the compact orbit closure identity component; an active exponential polynomial is nonzero analytically on each component, so its small-value set has asymptotic density vanishing as the threshold decreases. Weyl character criterion, logarithmic cutoff squeezing and inverse counting rigorously give both stated limits. Fourier inversion constructs every rational density, and two-symbol norm continuity follows from sup_n n r^n<infinity. Checked boundary cases q=1, finite group, rational q>=2, zero operator excluded.

value.rationale: The result exactly classifies a natural operator-theoretic invariant, the exponential approximation-number decay rate, for all finite strictly contracting equal-modulus rotation mixtures. It explains how algebraic rational relations and cancellation cause discontinuous rates under an operator-norm-continuous perturbation; it proves a complete inverse realization of every rational rate with arbitrary densities. This is a motivated sharp boundary not a numerical lookup or finite-case exercise.
